content.short: Ritual is a decentralized AI network that enables smart contracts to access and execute AI models trustlessly for all.
content.description: Ritual is a pioneering decentralized AI infrastructure network designed to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and blockchain technology. The platform features Infernet, a sophisticated AI oracle that allows smart contracts to trustlessly call any AI model for on-chain execution. This enables a wide variety of new use cases, from automated DeFi strategies to dynamic NFT generation, all secured by cryptographic proofs. Ritual acts as a foundational layer for the next generation of intelligent decentralized applications, often referred to as AI-Fi for global builders.
content.meta: Ritual provides a decentralized AI network and Infernet oracle for trustless AI-to-blockchain integration. Discover Ritual on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
